name: Gen Tiraan's R2-series astromech droid
description: An R2-series astromech droid was owned by Gen Tiraan, an engineer who helped design the Incom Corporation's X-wing starfighter. Tiraan had the droid with him in the Corellian system around 7 ABY, where he was of interest to both the New Republic and the Galactic Empire for the development of a newer and more efficient sublight engine.
